units.source_text: 到这一步，缩短后边的日数，

en.t: At this point, shortening the number of remaining days

units.source_text: 是为了让名人能从病痛中解脱出来，完成这盘棋而迫不得已采取的方法。

en.t: was a measure they had no choice but to take so that the Master could be freed from his pain and illness and finish this game.

units.source_text: 为了一盘棋，竟在温泉旅馆待上两三个月，真是太奢侈了。

en.t: To spend two or three months at a hot spring inn for the sake of a single game was really an extravagance.

units.source_text: 但这就是名副其实的“罐头式赛制”。

en.t: But this was truly what could be called a canned-match system.

units.source_text: 就是把人“关”在围棋这个罐头里。

en.t: It meant shutting people inside the can of go.

units.source_text: 这期间，假使每隔四天休息，回家一次，摆脱围棋，

en.t: During that time, if they had rested every four days, gone home once, and escaped from go,

units.source_text: 就可以散散心，消除一下疲劳。

en.t: they could have refreshed themselves and relieved a little of their fatigue.

units.source_text: 而实际上是把有关人员都禁闭在对局场地所在的旅馆里，

en.t: But in reality all the people concerned were confined in the inn where the match was being played,
and that made it impossible to relax.

units.source_text: 要是两三天或一周，问题倒不大，可关上两三个月，对六十五岁的老名人来说却是残酷的。

en.t: If it were only two or three days, or a week, it would not matter much, but being shut in for two or three months was cruel for the sixty-five-year-old Master.

units.source_text: 今天的对局，当然是照例禁闭，即使存在老人和时间长的问题，人们也不会认为这是缺德的吧。

en.t: Today’s match, of course, involved the usual confinement, and even with the issues of old age and the length of time, people probably would not think it immoral.

units.source_text: 或许连名人也把这种过分的对局条件看成是英雄的桂冠呢。

en.t: Perhaps even the Master himself regarded these excessive playing conditions as a hero’s laurel crown.
